figures.finding: Serbia's stage and screen actors' body is the Association of Dramatic Artists of Serbia (UDUS), Belgrade: a regular member must hold a drama-arts degree, or another qualification with at least four years' continuous professional work with relevant results; one applies with an accession form and evidence, decided by the commission for members' status rights, and membership lapses after 12 months' unpaid dues. Film actors also have their own association (Udruženje filmskih glumaca Srbije).
